summary: Frontend-only verification of RAF CBAT authoritative tweaks (post-rafcbat.wordpress.com) to 5 rewritten modules. ALL 5 modules render, expose the newly-added data-testids, transition through phases correctly, respond to keyboard + mouse, and produce zero console/runtime errors. All 15 non-rewritten modules also start Practice+Easy without errors (regression clean). Dashboard, Admin, Score History, and Gamepad Calibration pages all load. Screenshot of Target Recognition confirms 4 concurrent tasks (Light 3-bar target vs panel + MATCH; Scan 2-Wheeler + scanning panel + MATCH; Scene 'Click all friendly tanks travelling S' brief + 15-shape grid with direction arrows; System 4-char code WNWW + 19-row scrolling list). Detailed per-module results: (a) Vigilance: vg-row-input / vg-col-input / vg-submit-loc / vg-total / vg-routine / vg-priority / vg-wrong all present; typing wrong coords with no star present kept vg-wrong=0 (correct — grid empty at t=0.5s before first spawn); TIP text 'Priority (yellow) stars expire in 6s' rendered; row 1-9 x col 1-9 grid with column and row header cells rendered. (b) Situational Awareness: sa-grid + sa-ctrl-0 + sa-ctrl-1 rendered in study phase; after 15s countdown the grid is REPLACED with 'GRID HIDDEN' banner and controllers panel shows 'HIDDEN', sa-question + 4 sa-answer-<i> buttons appear; clicking an answer advances. (c) Table Reading: tr-grid (real -17..+17 lookup with sticky header + scroll), tr-first, tr-second (yellow), tr-answer-0..4 all present; keyboard '3' selection accepted without error. (d) Target Recognition: tr-light-target / tr-light-panel / tr-light-match / tr-scan-target / tr-scan-panel / tr-scan-match / tr-scene-brief / tr-scene-panel / tr-sys-target / tr-sys-list / tr-sys-row-0 all present in a single-screen 3-column layout; light panel & scan panel cycle every 1s via setInterval; clicking MATCH updated score. (e) Trace Test 1: tt1-scene + tt1-up/down/left/right rendered; ArrowUp keydown accepted and correct/wrong overlay flow works. REGRESSION: all 15 other modules (airborne-numerical, angles-bearings-degrees, auditory-capacity, cognitive-updating, colours-letters-numbers, digit-recognition, instrument-comprehension, mathematics-reasoning, numerical-operations, rapid-tracking, sensory-motor, spatial-integration, system-logic, trace-test-2, visual-search) reach the test screen via Practice+Easy+Continue with zero console errors. OTHER PAGES: / (module-card-vigilance found), /admin (admin-gamepad-link found), /history (hist-total found), /gamepad (gp-status found). Compilation clean; only pre-existing eslint warnings in SensoryMotor.js (not related to this iteration).

integration_issues.issue: clickSystemRow only increments score.system on match; wrong-row clicks are silently ignored (no miss counter). Problem statement says 'Clicking wrong things increases miss counts'. Consider incrementing a systemMiss counter on non-target row clicks for consistency with Light/Scan/Scene sub-tasks.

issues: Directional arrows on top of colored shapes are quite small (~16px SVG arrows) and low-contrast on the yellow/red fill. On downscaled displays they can be hard to read at a glance. Consider increasing arrow stroke-width or using a dark outline halo.
'Priority Miss' row has no data-testid (only Total/Routine/Priority/Wrong have testids). Not blocking but inconsistent with the rest of the score rows for automated verification.

action_items: OPTIONAL: In TargetRecognition.js clickSystemRow, increment a systemMiss counter when code !== systemTarget and surface it on the results page.
OPTIONAL: Add data-testid="vg-priority-miss" to the Priority Miss row in Vigilance for testability parity.
OPTIONAL: Increase visibility of scene direction arrows in TargetRecognition renderShape (stroke-width 2.5 + drop-shadow or dark outline).
critical_code_review_comments: TargetRecognition.js line 61-65: systemList useState initializer references systemTarget from the closure — this works because setSystemTarget on line 60 is declared first in the same render, but it is a subtle ordering coupling. In start(), the code correctly generates target THEN list. The initial-render inconsistency has no functional impact but is worth a comment.
TargetRecognition.js: clickSystemRow only tracks hits, not misses (see integration_issue above).

Vigilance.js line 108: raw score uses -statsRef.current.priorityMisses AND -statsRef.current.wrong, but statsRef.misses is incremented alongside priorityMisses when a priority star expires (line 54). The 'misses' field isn't used elsewhere — it's dead code. Consider removing.

TableReading.js buildGrid formula '(r*7 + c*3 + r*c/5) | 0' can produce duplicate values for many (r,c) pairs, which means multiple grid cells legitimately contain the same value. Distractors are answer+jitter, but if the grid coincidentally contains a distractor at (r,c) matching the target value, the candidate might reasonably pick a duplicate. Not a bug, just a fairness note.

SituationalAwareness.js line 150: uses (newIdx % 2 === 0) to spawn new round every 2 questions BUT the very first question uses idx=0 → newIdx=1 → not new round → good; but on newIdx=2 it calls beginRound which resets studyRemaining=15 while phase transitions to study, hiding the question. Working as designed per spec.

TraceTest.js: In multi-aircraft mode (medium/hard), the three renderAircraft calls all use the SAME scene.turn/facing so all three aircraft perform the identical maneuver — spec says 'candidate controls whichever is currently RED' but aircraft differentiation is only by color, not by maneuver. That is a fair test of color-tracking but not of maneuver-selection. Acceptable given spec interpretation.
cbtCommon.js exports many back-compat aliases (CBTPanel, CBTTestShell) — fine; consider consolidating to CFAST* names in a future refactor.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (5/5 rewritten modules PASS, 15/15 regression modules PASS, 4/4 other pages PASS)

seed_data_creation: None — tests run against fresh localStorage.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All new testids from this iteration (vg-*, sa-*, tr-* for both TableReading and TargetRecognition modules, tt1-*) are stable and render on first mount of the test stage. NOTE: 'tr-*' testid prefix is REUSED by BOTH TableReading (tr-grid, tr-first, tr-second, tr-answer-<i>, tr-p2-*, tr-chart-p2) AND TargetRecognition (tr-light-*, tr-scan-*, tr-scene-*, tr-sys-*) — they never coexist on the same page so it's safe, but be aware when writing cross-module tests. SituationalAwareness study phase is hard-coded to 15s regardless of difficulty; wait ≥16s before expecting sa-question. TargetRecognition light/scan panels cycle every 1s — take screenshot with wait_for_timeout(500) after mount to avoid catching mid-cycle blank state. TraceTest feedback overlay lasts 500ms then advances.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs blocking the feature. Minor optional improvements listed in action_items.
